howto: Swipe a shape onto a neighbour, or tap one shape and then the one next to it, to swap them.
A swap only counts when it lines up 3 or more of the same shape; otherwise it is undone and costs nothing.
Matched lines vanish, new shapes fall in, and chain reactions build a combo.
Reach 100 points before your moves run out.
tips: Swaps near the bottom shake up more of the board and often start chain reactions.
Each line in a chain scores 10 x the combo, so a 3-chain is worth 60.
If no swap works the board reshuffles for free.
Hint outlines a working swap in gold.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move the white cursor; Space picks a shape, then an arrow swaps it that way. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe a shape towards a neighbour, or tap two neighbours in turn. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy gives 25 moves to reach 100 points, Normal 20, Hard 15.

cheats.effect: A working swap is always outlined in gold

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the result card
features.best-score-badge: BEST top right, above the board
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated swipe; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: MATCH MASTER! or OUT OF MOVES card with score and best
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-match-swipe blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
